name: Pixel Agent Status
description: Eight animated 9×9 pixel glyphs for what an AI agent is doing, drawn in your text colour; only done (green) and error (red) carry colour. Zero re-renders.
usage:
import { PixelStatus } from "@/components/design-for-ai/pixel-agent-status";

Reading the docs…

props.name: state
props.description: Which glyph to animate. On the PixelAgentStatus gallery, holds the run row on this state.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered size in px. Under 28px dots thicken and the glow drops so it stays crisp. On the gallery it sets the tile glyphs (default 96).

props.name: color
props.description: Override the state’s colour. Work-in-progress states default to currentColor, idle to #a1a1aa, done #34d399, error #f87171 (see STATE_COLORS). On the gallery it tints only the work-in-progress tiles.

props.name: grid
props.description: Show the faint unlit dots behind the glyph (also each gallery tile).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label; defaults to the state name.

props.name: replay
props.description: Change it to replay the animation from frame one (e.g. on hover).

props.name: active
props.description: Hold the glyph dark (grid only) until true, e.g. to power it on once it has arrived on screen.
